questions: At kp 3.2 with kd 0.5, does oval steering_oscillation fall below 0.25 from 0.292, and what is the oval progress and finish count?
Does the score stay at or above 215.38? If it falls, is the controller the cause, given that the geometry is held?
Does s-bend max_error stay near 0.061 to 0.063 m, which would confirm that track width alone cannot reach the 0.06 m floor?
Do slalom and s-bend line_loss_events stay at or below 1.25 per run?
feedback_request.requested_changes_if_any: If the score is at or above 215 and oval oscillation is still above 0.25 at kp 3.2: keep the geometry and lower kp further, and do not change the sensor array. If the score is at or above 215, oscillation is below 0.25, and s-bend max_error is still above 0.06 m: I may propose wheel_track 0.08 m in iteration 10 with kp lowered to hold kp / wheel_track near 37.5. If the score falls below 215: keep wheel_track 0.09 m and report the controller settings used, treating kp 3.2 as the suspect.

intent: Hold the iteration 8 geometry exactly (wheel_track 0.09 m, five 12 mm sensors at x = -0.024 to +0.024 m and y = 0.04 m, wheel radius 0.03 m, body 0.12 x 0.18 m, mass 0.6 kg) so that the race isolates the Integrator's controller change (kp 3.2, kd 0.5). No geometry change this iteration. Expected result: a score at or above 215, oval steering_oscillation below about 0.25, and s-bend and slalom line-loss events at or below 1.25 per run.
learning: Iteration 8 showed that the controller change (kp 3.5 at 0.09 m) raised the score from 153 to 215, with the gain concentrated on the oval and slalom. Track-width gains on the s-bend have flattened at about 0.063 m. Sensing changes (iterations 1 to 3) all lowered the score. Next, read this race against the iteration 8 baseline of 215.38 on all three tracks, and treat the oval oscillation as the main open signal.
rationale:
Iteration 8 (wheel_track 0.09 m, five 12 mm sensors at x = -0.024 to +0.024 m and y = 0.04 m, 0.6 kg, kp 3.5) scored 215.38, the best result so far. Its oval finish rate rose to 0.30 and its s-bend max_error fell to 0.0612 m. Five-sensor geometry with wheel_track 0.09 m is the best-supported platform, and every sensing change tested in iterations 1 to 3 lowered the score.

The remaining problems are oval steering_oscillation of 0.292, above the 0.25 caution level, and s-bend max_error still above the 0.06 m off-track floor. The s-bend max_error has been flat at 0.063 to 0.064 m across track widths 0.10 to 0.09 m, so further narrowing alone is unlikely to fix it. Narrowing to 0.08 m would add about 12 percent more yaw gain per command, which the oscillation already shows is at its limit. I considered proposing 0.08 m now, but the Integrator's controller (kp 3.2 with kd 0.5) is tuned to the 0.09 m geometry. Changing the track now would confound that controller test and could cost the 215 baseline. I therefore hold every geometry value at iteration 8's settings. The only change this iteration is the Integrator's kp 3.5 to 3.2, which lowers yaw gain to bring oscillation under 0.25. Expected result: a score at or above 215, oval steering_oscillation below about 0.25, and s-bend and slalom line loss at or below 1.25 per run. If oscillation stays above 0.25 at kp 3.2, the limit is yaw gain at this track width, and I will not widen the sensor array.
